reading: The identities below are the durable record; the per-row over_admitted / admitted_the_disposition / admitted_the_response_request columns are counterfactuals over the corpus as of corpus_vintage — what a cell provisioned against that blob would have admitted under the pre-repair stamp. They over-count against a cell provisioned when the docket was shorter and under-count where the stored snapshot predates filings the docket later gained; they bound exposure, they measure no committed cell.

derivation.command: fedcourts backfill-arrival-stamps (dry-run, no --apply), plus one instrumented re-run of the same pass capturing the unchanged/unparsed identities its ledger counts but does not enumerate
derivation.input: the pre-apply corpus index object, fetched via the out-of-band pointer override under the read-only role; sha256-verified on download, object size 1147404288 bytes confirmed against the store
derivation.equivalence: a local dev-checkout dry-run, not the registered run-repair dispatch; equivalent because the pass is deterministic over a fixed blob, and verified so: every registered figure of the apply entry in docs/freeze-record.md reproduced exactly
derivation.discharges: the apply entry's clause that a permanent copy of the filled list be committed before the pre-apply object lapses (~30-day lifecycle)
